video_title: Are LeBron’s Sixers Already a Better Fit Than His First Heat Team?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers are a more complete team than the first Heat team
quotes.excerpt: This looks more natural than a first year of the Miami Heat.
quotes.quote: This looks more natural than a first year of the Miami Heat. They have less gaps. With the 76ers, remember they added Mike Miller, they had Sam Dalembert, but their shooting was still iffy. LeBron wasn't as confident in his shot, Dwyane Wade, so they were still lacking shooting and they were figuring it out. They were winning on talent. But when they added Ray Allen to that bad boy, he was like, oh yeah. When they added Ray Allen to that bad boy, you were like, oh yeah.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse's system maximizes the 76ers' offensive potential
quotes.excerpt: He's going to say, hey, you give me 34 minutes, I'm going to make sure within this system.
quotes.quote: They have guys who are bought in to the system and knowing how Nick Nurse coaches, he's going to say, hey, you give me 34 minutes, I'm going to make sure within this system, you still get the shots that you need. Just trust it. We got to get these guys going.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James was the final puzzle piece for the Heat
quotes.excerpt: LeBron was kind of that final puzzle piece and Ray, and that's why there was so much beef.
quotes.quote: LeBron was kind of that final puzzle piece and Ray, and that's why there was so much beef, like him leaving the Celtics to go to Miami. It wasn't the drama, I'm talking about from a roster construction. LeBron is kind of that final connecting piece that can help the engine, like that finalizing. When Ray Allen went to Miami and they were like, oh now, and then he went to somewhat of a rival because Bron was a rival to the Celtics, but it's like, now he goes there and you're like, oh that's, I promise you at the start of the season everybody was like, oh that's unfair. Okay, now this is getting ridiculous.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers are winning games by double digits
quotes.excerpt: I think three of these games that they won, they were down by double digits.
quotes.quote: I think three of these games that they won, they were down by double digits. Not 10 points, they were down huge. They found a way to turn it up defensively and turn it up offensively and they're going to continue to get better.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers have four players who can close games
quotes.excerpt: They have four guys that could close a game for them.
quotes.quote: They have something that no other team in the NBA has. They have four guys that could close a game for them. They have four guys that on any given night, that in any given series, any given game in a series, when it's a possession-by-possession in the fourth quarter, they got four go-to guys that could close. They could go to Tyrese Maxey, if he got it going, Jaylen Brown, and Joel Embiid.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is currently in cruise mode
quotes.quote: He's in straight cruise mode. I hope they know, like he's chilling. He's like deferring. He'll shoot a couple shots. What's he averaging, like 15 or 16? He's chilling. But they need to know he's chilling because when he ramps it up, so does the accountability, the intensity, and everybody else like, hey motherfucker.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers need to get Joel Embiid going more
quotes.excerpt: I just want to see them find a way to get Joel Embiid going just a little bit more.
quotes.quote: I just want to see them find a way to get Joel Embiid going just a little bit more. He's kind of looking offensively, and by the way, he's doing an outstanding job for a young player of buying in because he doesn't have bad body language. When you look at him last year, he finished third, second in rookie of the year. He had some moments. He was considered a go-to guy for them and now he has to take a backseat.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey has the potential to be a multi-time All-Star
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey in my opinion is going to be a future All-Star in this league.
quotes.quote: Tyrese Maxey in my opinion is going to be a future All-Star in this league. Has a chance to be a multi-time All-Star. Right now, you are so blessed to be and able to learn because what he's learning and how to win, Bron said he had to go to Miami to learn how to win and that's and he was a multi-time MVP. So, Tyrese Maxey gets a great opportunity.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey's priority must be fourth on the list
quotes.excerpt: His priorities, he has to be fourth on the priority list.
quotes.quote: His priorities, he has to be fourth on the priority list. So, and we know that. It's not even just four shots, it's like mentality wise, we got to make sure Bron's okay mentally, Tyrese is okay mentally, Jaylen Brown is okay mentally, Joel Embiid is okay mentally, and then you get to Tyrese Maxey. So, that's the part and that's not a knock on him, that's just the pecking order.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey should aim to make an All-Defensive team
quotes.excerpt: My advice to Tyrese Maxey would be, hey bro, go make an all-defensive team.
quotes.quote: My advice to Tyrese Maxey would be, hey bro, go make an all-defensive team. By the time we finished talking about you this season, let us talk about you as being one of the best wing defenders in the game.
